definitions.explanation: A pause from work or activity to rest.

examples.japanese: 10⟦{分|ぷん}→分：00928_fun⟧{休憩|きゅうけい}⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
{休憩|きゅうけい}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{休憩|きゅうけい}⟦{室|しつ}→室：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: To rest in the break room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{休憩|きゅうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We took a break in the middle of the long meeting.

examples.english: Since I was tired from driving, I decided to take a break at the service area.

notes:
{休憩|きゅうけい} refers to a break or rest period, typically during work, travel, or activities. It can function as a noun or する verb.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {休憩|きゅうけい}{時間|じかん}: break time
- {休憩|きゅうけい}{室|しつ}: break room, lounge
- {休憩|きゅうけい}{所|じょ}: rest area, rest stop

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}る: to take a break
- {休憩|きゅうけい}する: to rest, to take a break
- {休憩|きゅうけい}に{入|はい}る: to go on break

RELATED WORDS:
- {休|やす}む: to rest (more general)
- {休息|きゅうそく}: rest, repose (more formal/literary)
- {一休|ひとやす}み: a short rest
